Subject: HelixAI hands-on recap + action items (Aug 23)

Hi all —

Thanks for a productive session today. Quick recap and agreed next steps below. Attached: session recording link (session-recording-link.txt), final runbook PDF (redwood-runbook-v1.pdf), and the prompt CSV with the edits we made (helix-prompt-set.csv).

Summary highlights:
- Prompt review: adjusted system prompt to reduce instruction hallucination on edge cases; sample pass-rate improved from 68% -> 86% on our test harness during the session.
- Routing: verified chat vs. completion split with new routing rule (user.intent.score > 0.7 -> chat backend). Trace sampling showed expected fallback to v-cpu variant under simulated node loss.
- Surge/load: targeted 45 concurrent streams for 1k-token sequences during the 60m window. Average p95 latency for the primary model was 420ms, p99 at 1.2s — within our SLA threshold.

Action items (owner — due):
- Priya (Helix) — provide final production prompt set (CSV) with business labels for entities — due 2028-08-30.
- Marcus (Redwood) — export final test metrics and the KV cache warm/cold comparison CSV — due 2028-08-28.
- Ben (Redwood) — enable telemetry dashboard share for Helix and add a short how-to note for trace correlation — due 2028-08-25.
- Rachel (Redwood) — produce a brief follow-up note with recommended Dedicated sizing and estimated monthly run-rate at 80% utilization — due 2028-08-29.

Next session: suggested follow-up is a half-day optimization workshop (prompt tuning + rollout canary) the week of Sep 4. I’ll send a Doodle poll for availability — if Helix prefers earlier, let me know and we’ll try to accommodate.

Thanks again — please reply if any owners want to reassign or change due dates.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com
